name: Know Your Clown
tagline: A hopeful degen enters the Ministry of Airdrops for a life-changing allocation. A stamp arm labels him exit liquidity, his clown nose arrives at 1.5×, his dog testifies against him, and the verification escalates into an ancestral audit, a CAPTCHA ballet and a soul appraisal. Procedures keep coming for as long as the round runs. Paper-hand the claim in a tinfoil poncho before the machine crates his identity and dispenses one peanut.
